description: Market-neutral, multi-strategy digital asset manager running pooled funds, separately managed accounts and on-chain vaults for institutional and crypto-native allocators.

main_fund.name: Main Fund (direct investment)
main_fund.structure: USD-denominated pooled fund with an independent administrator and auditor
main_fund.strategy: Market-neutral, multi-strategy approach (basis/funding-rate carry, statistical arbitrage, options volatility) targeting stable, risk-adjusted returns
main_fund.track_record: 3-year track record, ~19% average annual net return, Sharpe ratio ~4
main_fund.liquidity: Monthly subscriptions; quarterly redemptions with 45-day notice
main_fund.transparency: Monthly NAV statements and an annual audit
best_for: Investors who want a turnkey, professionally managed allocation in a standard fund structure
Allocators who think and report in USD
Traditional/TradFi-style allocators who value institutional documentation and audited statements
Comfortable with periodic (not daily) liquidity and a pooled vehicle
not_for: Investors who want returns to stay BTC-denominated
Those who need on-chain, real-time verification or daily liquidity
Investors who require a bespoke mandate or direct asset ownership

btc_fund.name: BTC-Denominated Fund
btc_fund.structure: BTC share class of the main fund, subscribed and settled in BTC
btc_fund.strategy: Same underlying market-neutral, multi-strategy approach as the main fund, with performance measured in BTC
btc_fund.track_record: Same underlying 3-year track record as the main fund, ~17% average annual return in BTC terms
btc_fund.liquidity: Monthly subscriptions; quarterly redemptions with 45-day notice, settled in BTC
btc_fund.fees: 1.5% management / 20% performance (high-water mark), charged in BTC
btc_fund.transparency: Monthly NAV statements in BTC and USD, annual audit
best_for: Crypto-native investors, treasuries and family offices that hold BTC as their base/reserve asset
Those who want to grow their BTC stack without converting to fiat
Investors comfortable with the same pooled-fund structure and liquidity as the main fund
not_for: Investors who measure performance and report in USD or other fiat
Those who cannot hold BTC or have no BTC treasury policy
Investors needing bespoke terms or on-chain verification

sma.name: Separately Managed Account (SMA)
sma.structure: Dedicated account with a bespoke mandate; assets held in the client's own name/custody
sma.strategy: Customizable mandate (strategy mix, leverage and risk limits) drawing on the firm's core market-neutral strategies
sma.track_record: Built on the firm's core strategies: 3 years, ~19% average annual net return, Sharpe ~2.4
sma.liquidity: Negotiable, written into the managed-account agreement
best_for: Institutional and large private clients wanting bespoke strategy, risk limits or terms
Sophisticated allocators with their own custodian, prime broker and compliance infrastructure
Investors who want direct ownership of assets with no commingling
Larger tickets where operational setup cost is justified
not_for: Smaller allocations where setup overhead is not worth it
Investors wanting a simple, standardized turnkey product
Investors who need to deploy quickly (SMA setup takes time)

vault.name: On-Chain Vault (via Midas and/or Accountable)
vault.structure: Tokenized, on-chain vault product. Midas route: tokenized yield-bearing product held in the investor's wallet. Accountable route: vault with live, cryptographically verified reporting of assets, liabilities and capital flows.
vault.strategy: Delta-neutral stablecoin yield strategy, a conservative slice of the main fund's carry book
vault.track_record: 12 months live, ~9% net APY with low drawdown
vault.minimum_investment: $25,000 (lower than the pooled funds, suited to exploratory allocations)
vault.liquidity: Midas route: redeemable on request with a short processing window. Accountable route: queued, asynchronous redemptions, so withdrawals depend on available idle capital.
vault.fees: 10% performance fee embedded in vault mechanics, no management fee
vault.custody: On-chain / self-custody in the investor's own wallet
vault.transparency: Real-time on-chain verification (Accountable adds continuous cryptographic proofs of reserves and flows)
vault.target_return: ~8-12% APY, lower than the main fund, reflecting the liquidity and transparency trade-off
best_for: Crypto-native or DeFi-fluent investors, DAOs and corporate treasuries wanting a yield sleeve
Those who value real-time on-chain verification over periodic paper reporting
Investors who want faster or more flexible liquidity than a fund
Smaller or exploratory allocations to build the relationship before a larger commitment
Investors comfortable holding tokenized positions in their own wallet
not_for: Traditional allocators who need fund documentation, audit trails and a regulated wrapper
Those uncomfortable with wallets, self-custody or smart-contract risk
Investors seeking a managed, diversified multi-strategy program or the highest return target

denomination_preference.signal: Do they hold, measure and report in USD/fiat, or are they crypto-native and comfortable with BTC as their base currency?

customization_needs.signal: Do they emphasize bespoke or institutional mandates, or are standardized vehicles acceptable?

infrastructure_and_custody.signal: Do they have their own custodians, prime brokers and compliance team, rely on fund structures, or hold assets directly in self-custody wallets?

liquidity_needs.signal: Does their portfolio suggest they need flexible liquidity, or do they hold illiquid assets (PE, VC, real estate) showing comfort with lock-ups?

transparency_style.signal: Do they accept periodic NAV statements, want full position look-through, or prefer real-time on-chain verification?

ticket_size.signal: What AUM do they manage, and what is a plausible allocation size?

crypto_openness.signal: Do they already hold crypto/digital assets, or would this be a first allocation? Are they DeFi-fluent or TradFi-only?

scoring_guidance: Choose the product whose denomination, custody and transparency model matches how the prospect already operates. BTC fund: only score high with evidence they hold BTC as a reserve/base asset. Vault: favor crypto-native or DeFi-fluent prospects, treasuries and exploratory tickets; penalize TradFi-only prospects who need audited documentation. SMA: favor large or institutional prospects with their own custody/compliance or an explicit need for a bespoke mandate. Main fund: default for USD-reporting, TradFi-style allocators new to the space. Where a prospect fits several, say what an entry product and a graduation path could look like (e.g. start with the vault or main fund, graduate to an SMA).
